title: docs: update repo references for framework → objectstack rename
body:
## Summary

Follow-up to the GitHub repository rename **`objectstack-ai/framework` → `objectstack-ai/objectstack`**. Updates every reference to the old repo path, plus this repo's own identity artifacts.

## Changes
- Replaced `objectstack-ai/framework` → `objectstack-ai/objectstack` everywhere it names the GitHub repo: `package.json` `repository`/`bugs` URLs (56 packages), doc links, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `npx skills add …` install commands (string + regex forms).
- Renamed `framework.code-workspace` → `objectstack.code-workspace` (no in-repo references to update).
- Fixed the repo's own getting-started clone step — `cd framework` → `cd objectstack` in `README.md` and `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` — since the clone URL's default directory changed with the rename.
- Updated worktree examples in `AGENTS.md` (`../framework-<task>` → `../objectstack-<task>`).

## Deliberately unchanged
- The published npm package name **`@objectstack/framework`** — a repository rename does not rename a published package.
- Common-noun uses of "framework" (ObjectStack *is* a framework).

GitHub redirects old repo URLs to the new name, so nothing breaks during the transition; this simply makes the references canonical.
